title: Candlewick — chapter 6: Before the Bots
premise: Mrs. Pearl tells Ollie how she lost the Hill
cliffhanger: Then we heard footsteps on the dock. Too many. Walking in step.
nextOptions: Ollie and Mrs. Pearl escape through the canal
Ollie goes out to face the Bots alone
Milo shows up first and leads the Bots away

scenes.line: In my town, the green eye runs in the Flats. Mrs. Pearl had it first.
scenes.action: Mrs. Pearl looks down into her tea, her eyes glowing softly. Ollie listens, his own eye glowing the same green. She looks up at him.

scenes.line: She and the Whale were kids down here. They traded together. They never lost.
scenes.action: Flashback in faded colours: the two kids on the dock tap their old phones. Green sparkles rise from the screens. They laugh and bump shoulders.

scenes.line: Then one day, he won in public. Everyone saw.
scenes.action: The boy on the crate thrusts his phone higher, shouting. The crowd stares up at him. The girl at the edge reaches out to stop him, too late.

scenes.line: His eye went dark. Hers didn't.
scenes.action: The boy touches his eye; the green fades to dead grey. The girl's eye keeps glowing. They look at each other. Hold.

scenes.line: He went up the Hill and built the Bots, so he'd never need an eye again.
scenes.action: The young man in the white suit turns the wrench on the half-built Bot. The Bot's blank head turns up toward him. Behind him the rows of Bots stand perfectly still.

scenes.line: She stayed down here. Hiding. For fifty years.
scenes.action: Present day: Mrs. Pearl pulls the heavy curtain closed. Her face disappears behind it. Rain; the green Hill glows far above.

scenes.line: Then we heard footsteps on the dock. Too many. Walking in step.
scenes.action: The line of Bots marches along the dock in perfect step. The front Bot stops at the bottom of the steps. Ollie and Mrs. Pearl stay frozen inside. Hold.
